0.DSCR:
A super robot developed by the $$ビアル星人$$ to fight $$ガイゾック$$.
Three mecha -- $$ザンバード$$, which becomes the head and chest; $$ザンブル$$, which becomes the arms and abdomen; and $$ザンベース$$, which becomes the waist and legs -- combine into a giant robot with the form of justice and mystery, to the call of 'Zambot Combination In!'
Combining activates the ion engine, producing power truly worthy of the name 'Invincible Superman.' Its main weapons include the trident blade 'Zambot Grapple' that extends from its arms, the cross-shaped shuriken 'Zambot Buster' on its knees, and the 'Buster Missiles' that fire the projections of those shuriken. Its ultimate finishing move, the 'Zambot Moon Attack,' fires a crescent-shaped energy blast from the horn on its head.
In the suicide attack on $$バンドック$$ in the final battle, $$ザンブル$$ and $$ザンベース$$ exploded, and $$ザンボエース$$ also defeated $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ but was heavily damaged and fell toward the atmosphere.

1.DSCR:
A mobile fortress that serves as $$ガイゾック$$'s home base.
It can operate anywhere -- on land, undersea, or in space -- and inside are $$ブッチャー$$'s command room and the $$メカ・ブースト$$ manufacturing factory.
It fires the $$バンドック$$ Cannon from both arms, large missiles from its mouth, and destruction beams from its eyes, and also attacks with space mines and its freely extendable legs. It can generate a powerful barrier, giving it high defensive strength as well. Its head can also be separated from the main body for independent use, which was done when $$ブッチャー$$ personally launched an attack.
Its head was destroyed by a direct hit from the ion cannon that $$ザンボット３$$ received from $$ビアルⅠ世$$, and its main body by an attack from within $$ザンボエース$$.

2.DSCR:
$$万丈$$ seized the prototype $$メガボーグ$$ that $$破嵐創造$$ had developed on Mars, and completed it by making modifications.
It has a variable mechanism that transforms in three stages, and can transform into Dai Fighter and Dai Tank. The small variable fighter Mach Attacker is housed inside it, and its cockpit block moves through the machine's interior to become the pilot seat of $$ダイターン３$$.
Its main weapons include the sword 'Daitarn Zanber,' whose blade is made of beam; the fan-shaped 'Daitarn Fan,' which can also be used as a shield; and the 'Daitarn Web,' in which the cross on its arms transforms into a shuriken. Besides these, it has a great many weapons built into its whole body, such as missiles, cannons, and Snappers.
Its ultimate finishing move, the 'Sun Attack,' fires a ball of light from the sun emblem on its forehead, to the call of 'Borrowing the power of the sun, now the finishing move -- Sun Attack!'

3.DSCR:
A super robot that is the pride of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, the jack-of-all-trades of space.
It normally stands by in the park with only the upper half of its head exposed. When a job comes in, it launches after a double safety check of the surroundings: first an announcement from the clerk $$郁絵$$ that begins with 'Sorry for the disturbance as always,' then $$ワッ太$$'s own call of 'Safety check!' It is a robot deeply rooted in its community.
It was originally put into operation by $$ワッ太$$'s father, $$道太郎$$, to broaden the scope of the company's business, but he lost his life in an accident on the job. $$ワッ太$$ then took over as company president, and in doing so also inherited the pilot's seat.
Its greatest feature is that its base form, $$トライダーＧ７$$, can transform into as many as seven forms: the cruising form 'Trider Cosmic,' the heavy tank form 'Trider Beagle,' the fighter jet form 'Trider Eagle,' the small reconnaissance plane form 'Trider Hawk' (in which Trider's head separates from the torso and transforms), the surface and underwater form 'Trider Marine,' and the vehicle form 'Trider Mobile.'
At first glance it appears to be unarmed, but it stores numerous weapons within its body, including the 'Vulcan Missiles' fired from its fingertips. Each weapon is deployed instantly at $$ワッ太$$'s call, becoming Trider's great strength. Its strongest finishing move, the 'Trider Bird Attack,' wraps Trider in a Bird Beam that spreads out from the bird emblem on its chest, then rams into the enemy at high speed to tear it apart. It consumes a tremendous amount of energy, but its power is immense.
It boasts enough performance to have repelled every mecha-robot sent by the $$ロボット帝国$$ in its bid to conquer Earth, but its creator, too, was $$ナバロン$$, a former scientist of the $$ロボット帝国$$. He built Trider both to repay his debt to $$道太郎$$, who had once saved his life, and to fulfill his own dream of creating 'a robot with a heart' -- a dream he achieved. But $$ワッ太$$ and the others knew $$ナバロン$$ only as $$梅本$$, an Earthling, and, just as with the existence of the $$ロボット帝国$$, never learned his true identity to the very end.
Note that operating Trider requires a 'Robot License' -- not just anyone can pilot it.

5.DSCR:
A robot conceived and designed by Dr. $$金田$$, and completed by Dr. $$敷島$$.
It is operated by Rainbow Waves transmitted from $$正太郎$$'s Vision Controller, commonly known as the V-Con.
It is equipped with a solar energy conversion system that grants it a virtually unlimited operating time so long as there is sunlight, and an independent linkage system that lets it keep moving even if part of its body is destroyed. It also boasts a top flight speed of Mach 4.02, an underwater cruising speed of 40 knots, and a ground speed of up to 300 km/h, along with sensor lights incorporating radar equipment that let it operate in darkness -- making it capable of activity anywhere, space included.
In keeping with Dr. $$金田$$'s philosophy of it being a messenger of peace, it carries no dedicated weapons, but the hammer punches and flying kicks it unleashes with its sturdy super-alloy body are each devastating blows.
For all its high performance, its one weakness is that whether it does good or evil depends entirely on its remote control. When villains have seized the V-Con, it has carried out destructive acts exactly as they directed.
In the final battle, it released all of its solar energy at once, defeating the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ at the cost of itself. $$正太郎$$ was plunged into grief, but before long the V-Con responded again, and it returned safely.

6.DSCR:
A robot with a will of its own, developed in $$Ｘ団$$'s underground factory.
It was originally meant to have the entire brain of its creator, Dr. $$不乱拳$$, copied into it, but the copying process was cut short after only one hundred-thousandth of it was complete, leaving it with the intelligence of a three-year-old.
It rivals $$鉄人$$ in power, speed, and other measures of performance. Its eyes can also fire a powerful electromagnetic beam that stops any mechanical device.
After Dr. $$不乱拳$$ was killed by $$Ｘ団$$, it was entrusted to Dr. $$敷島$$ for a time, but $$ガンガル$$ of $$Ｘ団$$ disguised as Dr. $$不乱拳$$ and issued it orders, forcing it into battle against $$鉄人$$.
After $$ガンガル$$ was defeated, it began fighting alongside $$鉄人$$ of its own will, becoming a reliable ally.
It later received education from Dr. $$敷島$$, and its manner of fighting and behavior showed growth. When $$鉄人$$ was cornered by $$グーラ$$, it rushed in dashingly and saved $$鉄人$$ from that crisis.
It threw itself into the battles that followed as well, but after having a hypnosis device attached to it, it lost its sense of self and once again became $$鉄人$$'s enemy. The device was destroyed in the fighting and it came back to its senses, but in trying to make up for its own mistake it fought recklessly, and in the end it met its demise.

8.DSCR:
A robot that appeared in Episode 25, 'The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ Appears!'
The first $$スペースロボ$$ confirmed by Earth, with the appearance of a giant monster.
It fires a powerful mysterious red beam by crossing its antennae. It can also curl into a sphere to form a defensive posture that reinforces its armor, and in this form it completely blocked $$鉄人$$'s attacks. But $$正太郎$$ turned that against it, hurling the $$スペースロボ$$ into a $$巨大円盤|lc$$. Once its defensive form broke, it charged in head-on, but was defeated by a flying kick.

9.DSCR:
A robot that appeared in Episode 26, '$$ブランチ$$'s Final Moment.'
The second $$スペースロボ$$ sent out by $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army, with the appearance of a beetle.
Since it was the first time $$正太郎$$ had fought in outer space, the conditions were unfamiliar and the battle was a difficult one. However, thanks to the advice that $$ブランチ$$ left behind at the very end, after learning of having been used by $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, $$正太郎$$ found a way through, and the $$スペースロボ$$ fell before the fierce onslaught of $$正太郎$$ and $$鉄人$$.

11.DSCR:
A robot that appeared in Episode 48, 'Earth's Greatest Crisis!'
The fifth $$スペースロボ$$, piloted personally by $$グーラ$$, with the appearance of a lion.
It has performance surpassing every previous $$スペースロボ$$, and the sword-shaped beam it fires from its mouth is unmatched in power, easily piercing even $$鉄人$$'s super-alloy armor.
It drove $$鉄人$$ to the very brink of defeat, but was blocked by the arrival of $$ブラックオックス#robot$$, and fell before their combined attack.

12.DSCR:
A robot that appeared in Episode 50, 'Prince $$グーラ$$ Dies!'
The seventh $$スペースロボ$$, piloted by $$グーラ$$ after he resolved on a final battle with $$正太郎$$, with the appearance of a Western knight.
$$グーラ$$'s specialty, the sword attack, is powerful, and it also uses tricks such as hurling boulders with an electromagnetic net released from its fingertips. It fought a fierce battle against $$鉄人$$ on the surface of the Moon.
In the end, its sword was seized by $$鉄人$$ and it was cut in two by its own weapon.

proofread.reason: omitted subject: the Japanese 用いる has the robot (Space Robo No. 7) as subject but the English was a subjectless passive and the entry settles who; also 'its fingertips' (指先)

15.DSCR:
The demon king who rules the universe.
He was once human, but when his home planet was swallowed by a black hole, his will to live caused him to merge with it, and he survived as this being.
His personality is coldly merciless, and he rules the universe through fear and violence. Yet toward his son $$グーラ$$, he sometimes showed the warmer face of a parent.
At first he intended to swallow Earth whole in one stroke, but was talked out of it by $$グーラ$$'s pleading. However, when $$グーラ$$ lost his life in his showdown with $$鉄人$$, the demon king burned with rage and unleashed cataclysms upon the Earth.
When $$正太郎$$ and the others plunged into the Dark Sun at the black hole's core, he converted the power of his conviction into energy and appeared before them, driving $$鉄人$$ to the brink with overwhelming force.
In the end, he was annihilated along with the Dark Sun when $$鉄人$$ unleashed the full force of its solar energy.

16.DSCR:
A super robot that could be called Earth's guardian deity.
When $$タケル$$'s $$ガイヤー$$ falls into danger, the $$ゴッドマーズ$$ emblem appears on the screen inside the cockpit. Taking this as the signal that combination is possible, $$タケル$$ begins the sequence with a cry of '$$ゴッドマーズ$$!' Five robots fly in from different locations around the world -- the Sphinx, which houses $$ガイヤー$$, from Egypt; Uranus, which becomes the right arm, from the Arctic; $$タイタン$$, which becomes the left arm, from the Indian Ocean; Shin, which becomes the right leg, from Angkor Wat; and Ra, which becomes the left leg, from Easter Island -- and combine with $$ガイヤー$$ in the Six God Combination to form $$ゴッドマーズ$$, a body of super-alloy Positronium powered by anti-proton energy.
Its weapons are not especially numerous: God Fire, fired from the 'G' mark on its abdomen, and Mars Flash, a great sword given physical form from the same 'M' mark. However, since their power scales with $$タケル$$'s psychic abilities, they are more than sufficient in combat. The flip side is that they are also at the mercy of $$タケル$$'s mental state, and there were times when prolonged fighting and exhaustion sapped their power and led to a hard-fought battle.
Even after combining, each of the component robots can separate again, and scenes of them attacking with their own individual weapons, fired from their chests, or in hand-to-hand combat have also been seen.
Its finishing move is 'Final $$ゴッドマーズ$$,' which cleaves the enemy in two by combining Mars Flash with God Fire.
In the final battle against the revived $$ズール$$, it received the prayers of many people and shone gold, unleashing supernatural power.

proofread.reason: omission: 胸から放たれる固有武器 - the individual weapons are fired from the chest; the English dropped 'from the chest'

17.DSCR:
A fighter plane crewed by the $$クラッシャー隊$$.
$$ケンジ$$ commands, $$アキラ$$ pilots, $$ナオト$$ and $$タケル$$ handle attacks, and $$ミカ$$ is in charge of communications and reconnaissance. After $$ロゼ$$ pledged to cooperate with $$タケル$$ and the others, $$ロゼ$$ too boarded the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ and took over attack duties in $$タケル$$'s place.
It is an all-purpose machine capable of long-duration flight and operation both inside and outside the atmosphere. In peacetime it served as the $$クラッシャー隊$$'s transport, while in battle it worked tirelessly in every capacity, from direct combat against enemy fighters to supporting $$ガイヤー$$ and $$ゴッドマーズ$$.
It is formed by the combination of Unit 1, which becomes the fuselage and nose, and Unit 2, which becomes the rear section and main wings. It also carries a small Unit 3 inside it, and the 'Triple Laser,' in which all three units separate to attack from four directions at once, is a coordinated attack unique to the close-knit $$クラッシャー隊$$.

19.DSCR:
A combat mecha that appeared in Episode 57, 'Are You the $$バラの騎士$$...?!'
Piloted by the $$ゲシュタルト$$ members $$スナッパー$$ and $$ナッカー$$, it emerged from among the asteroids approaching Earth and attacked the $$クラッシャー隊$$.
It jammed the summoning of the five god robots with a brainwave-blocking beam fired from its head, cornering $$ガイヤー$$ as it was left unable to combine into $$ゴッドマーズ$$.
However, it was struck in the head by the sudden attack of the $$バラの騎士$$, cutting off the brainwave-blocking beam. Once it allowed the combination into $$ゴッドマーズ$$, it was destroyed in an instant.

proofread.reason: wrong referent: 'attacked the Crusher Team, piloted by the Gestalt members' reads as the Crusher Team being piloted; the Japanese says the Gestalt members Snapper and Nakker piloted the mecha (ゲシュタルトのスナッパーとナッカーの操縦で)

22.DSCR:
The giant form of $$ズール$$, the emperor of $$ギシン星$$.
Its weapons include an attack that restrains an opponent and bathes it in electric shocks, and a mysterious beam fired from its cape. Teleporting repeatedly at will, it showed power exceeding that of $$ゴッドマーズ$$.
When $$タケル$$, resigned to death, used an anti-proton bomb in the hope of at least bringing about mutual destruction, that life-staking act called forth a miracle. The energy of the explosion flowed into $$ズール$$'s body and only $$ズール$$ perished, bringing the war with $$ギシン星$$ to a close.
Later it revived and challenged $$ゴッドマーズ$$ once more, tormenting $$タケル$$ with overwhelming power, but in the end it was completely annihilated before the supernatural power of the golden-shining $$ゴッドマーズ$$.

26.DSCR:
A variant of the $$スコープドッグ$$, a type built for rough-terrain combat.
It is notable for its leg-mounted Trample Rigger, suited to crossing bad terrain, and the Droppers Folding Gun on its back, which enables long-range shooting.
Excelling in both firepower and off-road performance, it was the machine $$キリコ$$ used to assault $$アレギウム$$, the holy land of the $$マーティアル$$, single-handedly.

29.DSCR:
A representative H-class AT of the $$ギルガメス$$ forces.
Compared with the M-class 09 series, it is somewhat lacking in versatility and mobility, but it has enough high output and firepower to make up for it. The considerable margin in its design also paid off: it is easy to modify, and as a result many variant models were successfully produced.

35.DSCR:
An AT used by the Pan-Galactic Society $$マーティアル$$.
Developed with the sole purpose of defending the holy land of $$アレギウム$$, it is designed with movement through the forests and stone architecture around the holy land in mind.
It carries unique equipment: the Seilspyde, which fires a harpoon called the Harpune, and the Spinlad, which reels it back in. With these, it is capable of hoisting itself up and down, and of handling movement along the vertical axis as well.
This coloring is that of the machine piloted by $$テイタニア$$, who is being hunted by the $$マーティアル$$. In this machine, $$テイタニア$$ backed up $$キリコ$$ in the fight against the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$.

36.DSCR:
A black-bodied $$バーグラリードッグ$$ used by the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$.
It is notable for its folding head antenna, modeled on a bolt of lightning.
The shape of its Trample Rigger differs from that of $$キリコ$$'s machine.
Note that the Droppers Folding Gun on the back, which enables long-range shooting, was equipped by only some of the machines in the unit.

46.DSCR:
A Newtype-only mobile suit developed by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ at $$ロンド・ベル$$'s request. Pilot $$アムロ・レイ$$ handled its design personally.
Developed by analyzing the performance of previous Gundams and incorporating the latest technology, it was completed as an ultra-high-performance machine that belies its hurried construction.
The $$サイコ・フレーム$$ built in around the cockpit gives it extraordinary mobility and responsiveness. It is also the first Gundam-type mobile suit to be equipped with a $$サイコミュ$$ weapon, the Fin $$ファンネル$$. Larger than ordinary funnels, they output correspondingly more power. Besides their use as weapons, several can be linked together to generate an I-Field, forming an anti-beam barrier, making them useful in both offense and defense.
In order to stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s attempt to drop $$アクシズ$$, it challenged $$シャア$$'s $$サザビー$$, likewise equipped with a $$サイコ・フレーム$$, to a decisive battle, and won.
Afterward, the sight of it struggling to push $$アクシズ$$ back united the hearts of many people, and a shining force field formed by the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ altered $$アクシズ$$'s trajectory.
That light became known as the '$$アクシズ$$ Shock,' and it affected many people.

50.DSCR:
The flagship of the $$地球連邦軍$$' $$ロンド・ベル$$ task force.
Its captain is Colonel $$ブライト・ノア$$, and like the Gundam-carrying ships before it, white forms the base of its color scheme.
Besides its usual launch catapult, it is notable for a dedicated landing deck at the stern of the hull. It also has a highly armored combat bridge, separate from the bridge used under ordinary circumstances.
Its basic performance is high, and sister ships are still in service more than fifty years after its development.
Besides its main armament of four twin mega particle cannons, it carries countless missile launchers and machine guns.
Before the decisive battle, it was equipped with fifteen nuclear missiles handed over by $$カムラン$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation (tense): the Japanese 同型艦が就航している is present tense (sister ships ARE in service more than fifty years after development); the English said 'remained in service', turning a present state into a past event

53.DSCR:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
Developed at $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$' $$グラナダ$$ plant. Two units were built as prototypes, and the blue unit among them became $$ギュネイ$$'s personal machine.
It adopts a $$サイコ・フレーム$$, giving it excellent control responsiveness and readiness.
Besides a beam assault rifle, beam saber, and the quad mega particle cannon built into its shield, it carries six funnels.
In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, it distinguished itself by shooting down every nuclear missile fired by the $$ロンド・ベル$$ task force, but was itself shot down by the $$νガンダム$$.

54.DSCR:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
Developed at $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$' $$グラナダ$$ plant. Two units were built as prototypes, and the blue unit among them became $$ギュネイ$$'s personal machine.
It adopts a $$サイコ・フレーム$$, giving it excellent control responsiveness and readiness.
Besides a beam assault rifle, beam saber, and the quad mega particle cannon built into its shield, it carries six funnels.
In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, it distinguished itself by shooting down every nuclear missile fired by the $$ロンド・ベル$$ task force, but was itself shot down by the $$νガンダム$$.

59.DSCR:
A mainstay light cruiser of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
An evolution of the $$ムサイ$$-class, $$ジオン$$'s iconic warship.
It is equipped with folding heat-radiating fins and has high cruising performance.
In the surprise attack on $$ルナツー$$, numerous decoys of this ship were used to disguise the true size of the fleet.

60.DSCR:
The $$ガンダム$$ piloted by $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$.
Its distinguishing feature is the bird-wing-like plumage mounted on its back. These wing-shaped parts, called Wing Binders, produce extraordinary mobility and maneuverability. They also serve many other functions, such as a heat shield for atmospheric reentry and a shock absorber when firing the Buster Rifle.
This unit was developed with single-handed base capture as its main focus, and in addition to its mobility it possesses overwhelming firepower; its main armament, the Twin Buster Rifle, carries enough power to destroy a colony in a single blast. Its high mobility also lets it perform well in close combat with its beam saber.
Its cockpit houses the 'Zero System,' which communicates to the pilot's brain, through the console, the actions the system determines necessary for victory. Though an extremely useful system in combat, it places a heavy mental burden on the pilot and often causes them to run out of control. However, $$ヒイロ$$ overcame the system during the previous war and came to use it completely.
After the war it was meant to be disposed of by dropping it into the sun, but it returned to $$ヒイロ$$'s hands once more to suppress the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising, and fought $$アルトロンガンダム$$ just short of the atmosphere.
Next, in order to destroy the nuclear shelter of the presidential residence, in which $$マリーメイア$$ was holed up, it fired its Twin Buster Rifle in rapid succession despite being half-wrecked. It succeeded in destroying the shelter, but the recoil left the unit itself badly damaged as well, bringing its role to an end.

61.DSCR:
The $$ガンダム$$ piloted by $$デュオ$$.
With the Active Cloak on its back -- doubling as a shield and flight control unit -- spread wide, and its Beam Scissors held at the ready, its silhouette evokes the image of a 'Grim Reaper.'
Its Hyper Jammer, which temporarily disables enemy sensors, gives it high stealth capability, and it excels at attacking enemies from their blind spots.
Even in head-on combat, it boasts high close-combat ability with its Beam Scissors.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising was suppressed, believing weapons had no place in an age of peace, $$デュオ$$ personally scrapped it.

62.DSCR:
The $$ガンダム$$ piloted by $$トロワ$$.
Developed under the concept of single-handed base capture and combat against numerous targets, it carries a huge volume of firearms over its entire body.
The $$バートン財団$$ was involved in its development, and its main armament, the Double Gatling Gun, is also used by the $$サーペント$$.
With its elegant mobility, this unit wields two of these gatling guns at once, overwhelming the $$サーペント$$ forces.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising was suppressed, believing weapons had no place in an age of peace, $$トロワ$$ personally scrapped it.

63.DSCR:
The $$ガンダム$$ piloted by $$カトル$$.
A machine excelling in power and defense, with large Heat Shotels as its main armament.
Multiple sensors are mounted in its head, giving it excellent information-gathering ability. Using this information, it analyzes the battlefield situation and sends precise instructions to allied units.
Its armor strength is the highest among the five Gundams, and it can also equip a cloak fitted with reinforced armor and anti-beam coating.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army was suppressed, believing weapons had no place in an age of peace, $$カトル$$ personally scrapped it.

64.DSCR:
The $$ガンダム$$ piloted by $$五飛$$.
A machine specialized for close combat, with excellent mobility.
Its only carried weapon is the Twin Beam Trident, making it extremely specialized for melee combat, but the Dragon Fangs equipped on both arms also allow it to fight at medium range. Living up to the name 'Twin-Headed Dragon,' these weapons can freely extend and retract, and thanks to a multi-jointed structure of interlocking square segments, they can unleash flexible attacks.
It belonged to the $$マリーメイア$$ Army and stood in the way of $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, but after the uprising was suppressed, $$五飛$$ personally scrapped it.

70.DSCR:
The official notation is '$$ガンダムＤＸ$$' (pronounced 'Double X').
A mobile suit based on $$ガンダムＸ$$, developed by the $$政府再建委員会$$ with the aim of creating 'a new $$ガンダム$$ with mighty power as a symbol.'
Its base is the machine that $$ジャミル$$ piloted in the $$第７次宇宙戦争$$, but the latest technology has been introduced inside it, so it may well be called an entirely new machine. According to $$カトック$$, however, it is 'a ghost of the fifteenth year.'
The $$サテライトキャノン$$, the greatest feature of $$ガンダムＸ$$, has been increased to two, becoming the Twin $$サテライトキャノン$$. Its power has also more than doubled, strong enough to destroy even the artificial island $$ゾンダーエプタ$$ and the Colony Laser.
Dramatic improvements can be seen in every aspect, not only the $$サテライトキャノン$$ but also the machine's own output, mobility, and maneuverability. Its high performance can be gauged from the fact that in its first battle, despite being alone and without a rifle, it shot down as many as eight $$バリエント$$.
However, only its dedicated Buster Rifle, no longer integrated with the shield, seems to have backfired in terms of durability, and it was destroyed repeatedly. As a result, it was even forced at one point to fight with a rifle borrowed from the $$ガンダムエアマスター$$.

71.DSCR:
A mobile suit that emerged from the $$ホワイトドール$$ enshrined at the foot of the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ in $$ビシニティ$$, in $$イングレッサ$$ territory.
At first it had almost no weapons, and fought in close combat with its bare hands and beam sabers. Later, a rifle, shield, hammer, and other gear were excavated, and by equipping them it steadily improved its combat power.
It runs on the IFBD (I-Field Beam Drive), which spreads an I-Field generated from within across the machine's surface and controls the machine by controlling that field. Because it carries no generator or the like, its internal structure has room to spare, and the multipurpose silo (multi-purpose armory) in its chest can be loaded with various weapons as needed. In fact, $$ロラン$$ used it to transport all sorts of things, from cows to nuclear missiles.
Its armor, covered with nanomachines, has self-repair ability, and given time even missing parts can be regenerated.
The $$月光蝶$$ System, which could be called the greatest feature of the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$, disperses nanomachines carried on an I-Field, and is said to have destroyed the scientific civilization of the previous era.
The cockpit at its waist can separate and transform into a Core Fighter. It has next to no combat ability, but it is also an indispensable part for using the $$月光蝶$$ System correctly.
Note that only a very few people in the story called it 'Gundam'; most, starting with $$ロラン$$, called it the '$$ホワイトドール$$' or the 'White Mustache.'

72.DSCR:
$$ザフト$$'s newest mobile suit, developed to bring an end to the war with the $$地球連合$$ forces.
As $$シン$$ grew at a rapid pace, $$デュランダル$$, believing the $$インパルスガンダム$$ could no longer make full use of $$シン$$'s talent, had detailed adjustments made to this unit, making it effectively $$シン$$'s personal machine.
It is equipped with the 'Hyper Deuterion Engine,' a power plant that combines nuclear power with a Deuterion beam power transmission system, and it generates Wings of Light from its wing parts to display tremendous mobility.
It combines the strengths of all three of the $$インパルスガンダム$$'s forms, succeeding in achieving both a versatile arsenal effective at any range and outstanding mobility. It further adds unique functions such as palm-mounted beam cannons and an afterimage effect derived from Mirage Colloid technology, realizing the concept of a single unit capable of responding to any battlefield situation.
During the Battle of $$メサイア$$, it was badly damaged in combat with the $$インフィニットジャスティス$$ and fell to the lunar surface as is, withdrawing from the fighting.

75.DSCR:
$$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s fifth-generation $$ガンダム$$, developed as the successor to the $$ダブルオーライザー$$.
Piloted by $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$.
A machine developed under the concept of making maximum use of the abilities of $$刹那$$, who awakened as an $$イノベイター$$.
Its basic frame is built around the $$ダブルオーガンダム$$, which had already reached a state of near-perfection, but its internal components, such as its electronic systems, have been overhauled.
Like the $$ダブルオーガンダム$$, it adopts the $$ツインドライヴ$$ system, but because the GN Drives mounted in this unit were newly built with the $$ツインドライヴ$$ system as a premise from the start, it achieves full synchronization without needing the $$オーライザー$$.
Its distinctive armament is the GN Sword Bits. Its six Sword Bits can not only attack independently, but also generate a GN Field, letting them serve as shields as well. Linking them with the GN Sword V also turns them into powerful equipment such as the GN Buster Rifle and GN Buster Sword.
On paper, this unit was completed with combat power surpassing that of the $$ダブルオーライザー$$, but its ultimate purpose lies elsewhere, apart from combat.

When the Quantum System is activated and a Quantum Burst is performed, the armor on each part is purged, and the unit shifts into a posture that casts aside combat and engages in dialogue.
With that power, it succeeded in making the metallic life form $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ understand humanity, leading the fighting to an end.

77.DSCR:
The final battle specification of $$ガンダムサバーニャ$$.
Four GN Holster Bits in total were added on its shoulders, and the hand-held Rifle Bit II also became two guns, achieving a major increase in attack power.

78.DSCR:
$$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s fifth-generation $$ガンダム$$, an evolution of the $$アリオスガンダム$$.
Piloted by $$アレルヤ・ハプティズム$$ and $$マリー・パーファシー$$.
The $$ガンダム$$ types piloted by $$アレルヤ$$ had until now been developed with mobility as the priority, but this unit was developed under the concept of improving combat power through heavier armament, taking into account combat against numerous opponents.
As carried weapons, it is equipped with two GN Sword Rifles. With a GN Cannon and a large missile container as standard equipment on its back, its firepower has been greatly improved over the $$アリオス$$. The GN Sword Rifle is a dual-purpose weapon for both ranged and melee combat, and by deploying its sword section it can also be used as the GN Claw, the $$アリオス$$'s signature equipment.
It was developed from the start as a two-seater, allowing its increasingly complex fire control and machine control to be handled separately by its two pilots.

79.DSCR:
The final battle specification of $$ガンダムハルート$$.
Equipped with additional boosters on its legs, it has taken on a silhouette like that of a mobile armor.
Activating $$マルートモード$$ allows it to bring out to the fullest the abilities of the three super soldiers, $$アレルヤ$$, $$ハレルヤ$$, and $$ピーリス$$.
Upon activation of $$マルートモード$$, its head camera eye changes to six eyes.

80.DSCR:
A $$ガンダム$$ that $$ティエリア$$, sleeping within $$ヴェーダ$$, was secretly developing aboard the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$.
A machine developed based on the 'Ga' series used by the $$イノベイド$$s, it shows shared elements with them in many places.
Though its development path differs, it inherits the design philosophy of the $$ヴァーチェ$$ and $$セラヴィー$$, with the concept of a high-firepower mobile suit for base capture.
Its massive weapon unit on the head mounts the GN Big Cannon, a high-firepower weapon directly linked to a $$ＧＮドライヴ$$. The cannon can also be used as a giant GN Claw capable of remote operation.
As this unit was developed aboard the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$, it uses pseudo GN Drives, and three drives are mounted.

83.DSCR:
A mainstay mobile suit of the $$地球連邦軍#00$$.
There are commander and mass-production types; this coloring is the commander type's.
The former $$連邦軍$$' mainstay unit had been shifting to the $$アヘッド$$, but after $$アロウズ$$' atrocities came to light, production of the $$アヘッド$$, so strongly associated with that organization's image, was halted. In its place, this unit, a development of the GN-X series, was adopted as the mainstay unit of the $$地球連邦軍#00$$.
With the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$ placed under Federation control, $$ガンダム$$ technology has been actively diverted for its use, realizing the adoption of Trans-Am and backup support from $$ヴェーダ$$ as well.
A wide range of optional equipment exists, such as the GN Bazooka and GN Buster Sword, allowing for customization according to the mission and pilot, and the commander type has an even greater degree of freedom in that selection.

85.DSCR:
A technology test unit for the $$地球連邦軍#00$$, developed mainly by engineers from the former $$ユニオン$$ and $$ＡＥＵ$$.
It was developed with the concept of making the $$マスラオ$$, $$ミスター・ブシドー$$'s personal machine, more general-purpose, and organizing a rapid deployment force.
To meet this concept, the unit needed extended range and improved mobility, so it was fitted with a transformable cruising form that had been omitted from the $$マスラオ$$.
Its carried weapons, previously centered on melee combat, have been changed to ranged weapons such as the GN Beam Rifle. This weapon can be used not only as a high-output beam rifle, but its tip can also be removed to increase its rate of fire, allowing for a wide range of uses suited to the battlefield situation.
The commander type piloted by $$グラハム$$ is also equipped with two pseudo solar reactors and a large GN Beam Saber, allowing it to fight in melee combat just as the $$マスラオ$$ does.
It has already entered the evaluation testing phase, and early production units have been deployed to '$$ソルブレイヴス$$,' the squadron led by $$グラハム$$.
Being for commanders, this unit is painted blue, while the standard units ridden by $$ソルブレイヴス$$ members are painted green.

robot 54: the Japanese DSCR is byte-identical to robot 53 (same hashes; blue unit, Gyunei, Axis battle), so it has the same English. The Jigoku reference shown for 54 (entry 48, Quess's red unit) does not apply and was not used.

Jigoku sentences I did NOT keep verbatim because they did not match the Tengoku Japanese or the pronoun rule: robot 3 'fittingly, its creator was' -> 'but its creator, too, was' (Japanese is ...が...もまた), 'an ordinary Earthling' -> 'an Earthling', and the last-sentence 'or that of the Robot Empire' -> 'just as with the existence of the Robot Empire' (ロボット帝国の存在同様); robot 60 the Twin Buster Rifle sentence (Jigoku had a 'three shots only' drawback that Tengoku no longer contains); robot 6 'saved him' -> 'saved [Tetsujin]' and 'himself' removed (Gangal); robot 9, 17, 26, 35, 60, 61-64, 72: he/his/her/with his own hands rewritten to avoid gender not settled by the Japanese (Shotaro, Roze, Chirico, Titania, Mariemaia, Duo, Trowa, Quatre, Wufei, Shinn); robot 12 'his fingertips' -> 'the fingertips' (owner not stated); robot 9 'the Space Robo fell before Tetsujin's onslaught' now also names Shotaro (Japanese: 正太郎と鉄人の猛攻); robot 60 'beneath the presidential residence' -> 'of the presidential residence'.

Gender kept from Jigoku: Gura is he (title 王子 / 息子 in the entries); the Space Demon King (robot 15) keeps he/his/'his son' as in Jigoku, since the Japanese only says 魔王 and 息子. 魔王 in the subject-less sentence about the rage is 'the demon king' in lowercase, as in the first line.
